note: The script asks for the hook text, a number pop, one name super and two top text lines, so 5 graphics and the end card. Row 00:37–00:47 is captions only. The CASS logo file is not in endcards/ yet, so the end card types CASS until it is added.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: If a client had a case manager

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: If a client had a case manager Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Number pop
mg.cue: Number pop at 00:07 for 3 s, top band, as he says it: 3× / almost three times as likely.
mg.use: Start at 00:07 so the number lands on <almost three times>. Top band, over the B-roll shot.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:12 for 3 s, lower left above the captions: Richard Southee, PhD / Director of Compliance and Continuous Improvement, CASS.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:12 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Director of Compliance and Continuous Improvement, CASS under the name (Nick confirms the title).

mg.title: Top text

text.main: all criticism is feedback and all feedback is good.

mg.cue: Top text at 00:20 for 2.5 s, top band, as he says it: all criticism is feedback and all feedback is good.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:20 as he says it. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Top text

text.main: more like a thousand solutions to homelessness

mg.cue: Top text at 00:30 for 3 s, top band, as he says it: more like a thousand solutions to homelessness.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:30 as he says it, over the drone shot. Top band.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: CASS logo, then the line For more information visit cassaz.org.
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo file is in the repo yet (endcards/index.json has no CASS entry, checked 3 Nov 2026), so CASS is typed. Line from the script's end card row (cassaz.org, the CASS end card line in the client file); colours from the CASS brand (navy #2C2B77, white).
mg.use: After the last line at 00:47. Hold it to the end. Swap in the CASS logo once it is in the repo.
